creator.title: Creator assistant
creator.intro: Turn your brief into a script, caption and shot list. Review the draft before applying it.
creator.briefPh: What are you showing, who is it for, and what should viewers do? Include any facts the draft should use.
creator.durationInvalid: Choose a whole number from 10 to 180 seconds.
creator.privacy: Generating sends this brief, the post title, platform and current script to Cloudflare AI through your Worker. The daily budget targets 20 new drafts; simultaneous requests across servers can exceed it. Repeated requests reuse the draft for 24 hours.
creator.review: Check facts, wording and suggested hashtags. This draft has not been saved or scheduled.
creator.caption: Caption and suggested hashtags
creator.selectFields: Choose which fields to replace. Existing content starts unchecked.
creator.replace.script: Replace overview hook, script hook, three beats and CTA
creator.replace.caption: Replace caption and hashtags
creator.replace.shots: Replace shot list and reset its checkmarks
creator.applied: Selected fields saved. Your post has not been published or scheduled.
creator.exportTitle: Production files from your saved post
creator.subtitleHint: Subtitle timing is estimated from your script and target duration, not transcribed from audio. Adjust it in your editor. Add trending music inside TikTok before publishing.
creator.error.unconfigured: Set your Scout Worker URL and owner token in Settings to generate drafts. Production file exports work without AI.
creator.error.auth: The Worker rejected your owner token. Check the Scout connection in Settings.
creator.error.network: The draft request timed out or could not reach your Worker. Your post is unchanged; try again.
creator.error.bad_request: Check the brief and duration. The title must be under 201 characters, hook/CTA under 1,201, and each beat under 1,601.
creator.error.ai_limit: Today's draft generation allowance has been used. Try again after midnight UTC, or keep editing and exporting locally.
creator.error.ai_unavailable: The AI draft is unavailable or could not be validated. Your post is unchanged. Try again later.
creator.error.stale: This post changed after generation started. Generate a fresh draft to protect your latest edits; you can still download this preview.
